stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.
name: zai-status
purpose: ZAI /status: pinned's status matrix has NO ZAI arm, and its chain ends at :2062-2065 answering 400 { error: true } WITHOUT calling the provider. The mock script is therefore EMPTY: any outbound request would be answered by the mock default and would appear in the recording as a request pinned never made, which is exactly the divergence this scenario exists to catch.
